issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU2 FHIR-I change request asking that the FHIR build tool enforce that an element named 'div' only be used for Narrative.div, allowing format converters to treat div as the narrative XHTML element without consulting the schema every time.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation. Jira records a later 'already done' comment, and historical commit 0c4049e17ddc956f06240daaedace2d7f5808e0c (#9797 - enforce rule on type of element if named 'div') added the old ResourceValidator rule requiring any element named div to have type xhtml.
additional_context: The current core checkout no longer contains the Java build-tool source; build.gradle.kts invokes org.hl7.fhir.tools.publisher.Publisher from the external org.hl7.fhir:kindling dependency. The current HL7/kindling ResourceValidator still contains the same rule. In current core source, source/fhir.ini keeps Narrative active as infrastructure, source/datatypes/narrative.xml defines Narrative.div with type xhtml, and a source scan found no other element-definition rows ending in .div. The Zulip thread linked from Jira confirms the original intent and Grahame's contemporaneous note that the rule was added.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source change is needed because both the authoritative core source and the current external build-tool rule already match FHIR-9797.
